subject: Deployment governance & regional commitment — MAP and eval timeline
messages:
From: Sophie Martinez <sophie@mediq.ai>
To: naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Singh <r.singh@healthxcorp.com>
Date: Fri, 9 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff — deployment constraints & regional question

Hi Naomi / Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with the latency profile. We want to lock down a mutual action plan (MAP) so our security, procurement and cloud teams can align on a target close date. A couple of asks to start:

- We need a short eval plan that shows what changes across Hosted / Dedicated / Private will look like from a compliance & latency perspective.
- Are there any hard region constraints? Our primary production data residency needs to be in US (HIPAA) but a small analytics shard could live in eu-west for redundancy.
- Can you surface any KMS/HSM options (customer-managed) if we move to Dedicated or Private?

Attached is a simple checklist from our compliance team. Looking for a 3–4 week MAP window to final decision if we can get the procurement paperwork moving.

Best,
Sophie Martinez
Head of Platform Ops
MediQ

Attachment: mediq_compliance_checklist.pdf (PDF stub)

From: naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Martinez <sophie@mediq.ai>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 9 May 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — deployment constraints & regional question

Thanks Sophie — great to be moving quickly. Summary and proposed MAP below. I copied Ben (Solutions) and Marissa (Customer Success) to coordinate the PoC and procurement.

High-level eval plan (summary):
- Week 1 (PoC prep): confirm dataset subset, test harness, required sequence length profiles.
- Week 2 (Hosted vs Dedicated perf): run the same workloads against Hosted (redwood-managed) and a Dedicated pool with 2x GPUs; capture latency p50/p95 and token cost.
- Week 3 (Private / security deep-dive): provide a checklist for Private deployment (networking, KMS integration, audit logs) and a sample SOC2 evidence pack.
- Week 4 (Decision & procurement): finalize preferred deployment mode, region selection, and procurement paperwork (SOW/PO).

Decision criteria (scorecard we will use):
- Latency SLO adherence (p95 under 450ms)
- Cost per 1k tokens (relative delta to Hosted baseline)
- Data residency & technical feasibility (KMS, egress controls)
- Operational complexity (ops runbook and RTO/RPO)

Region notes: we can run production in us-east-1 (recommended for lowest latency to your US endpoints). If you require eu-west for analytics, we propose an asynchronous replica; we will list any cross-region egress costs in the MAP.

KMS/HSM: For Dedicated we support customer-managed KMS with key rotation and HSM-backed keys in our Dedicated offering; Private allows direct HSM attachment. We will include a short KMS requirements doc in the Week 3 pack (attached: SOC2_evidence_request.pdf).

Deliverables I will share by EOD Monday: MAP_v1.xlsx (milestones), a minimal PoC test plan, and the compliance evidence index. Please confirm any additional stakeholders to loop in.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP_v1.xlsx (Excel stub), SOC2_evidence_request.pdf (PDF stub)

From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 12 May 2025 08:29:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — deployment constraints & regional question

Sophie — quick follow up on the MAP milestones. Naomi shared the draft — I've added measurable acceptance gates so procurement can move in parallel.

Key MAP milestones (high level):
1) PoC sign-off (technical): pass perf and correctness tests against host/dev dataset (target 2025-05-16).
2) Security review: complete SOC2 evidence review and KMS integration checklist (target 2025-05-19).
3) Commercial: finalize SOW + pricing for Dedicated + Private options (target 2025-05-21).
4) Exec approval: CISO and VP Product sign-off for chosen mode (target 2025-05-23).

Notes: If you prefer an expedited track, we can compress Weeks 2–3 into a 6-business-day intensive eval and aim for an earlier commit. Ben — FYI please prepare a quick cost delta table for Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private for the PoC load.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 13 May 2025 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — deployment constraints & regional question

Thanks — this looks good. A couple clarifications from our infra team:
- We absolutely need production data residency in US-only (HIPAA). The analytics replica in eu-west is optional and needs to be read-only with encryption in transit at rest.
- We prefer Dedicated if the cost delta is <= 30% and latency p95 improves by at least 20% versus Hosted. Otherwise we will consider Hosted with caching.
- KMS: we will need an HSM-backed key for PHI at rest for Dedicated or Private. Please include implementation notes in your Week 3 pack.

We can commit to the PoC sign-off date 2025-05-16 if the test harness is ready by 2025-05-14.

Sophie

Attachment: mediq_infra_notes.txt (text stub)

From: naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Martinez <sophie@mediq.ai>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rajiv Singh <r.singh@healthxcorp.com>
Date: Tue, 13 May 2025 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — deployment constraints & regional question

Great — thanks for the clarity Sophie. Confirming next steps and our commitments below: 

- PoC harness delivery: Redwood will deliver the harness & datasets by 2025-05-14 EOD. Ben will share the Hosted vs Dedicated cost delta table tomorrow morning.
- KMS/HSM notes: we will include an implementation appendix showing HSM-backed CMKs for Dedicated and an architecture sketch for Private with on-prem HSM attachment. Appendix will be in Week 3 pack.
- Regional setup: we'll stage the PoC in us-east-1 for production parity. If you sign off on the analytics replica, we will provision eu-west-1 as an async replica and include traffic routing and egress cost estimates.
- MAP commit: aiming for final decision by 2025-05-23. If the PoC goes as expected and the cost delta meets your threshold (<=30% with required perf wins), we will recommend Dedicated in us-east-1 with canary rollout. Otherwise we'll recommend Hosted with prefix caching and a follow-up roadmap to Dedicated.

I'll upload MAP_v1.xlsx and the procurement stub to the HubSpot deal and share links. Thanks everyone — looking forward to the PoC.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference

Attachments: poa_proposal-dedicated.pdf (PDF stub)
